compiler_summary: Create a new mutable extension with one Hook that injects the multi-hop decomposition instruction into stage.model_input at every post_prompt invocation. Since SimplePromptBuilder.build() reconstructs fresh ModelInput each step from [template, question, conversation_messages], a one-shot injection would be lost by step 2. Injecting at every post_prompt achieves the coordinator intent of 'persists for the entire episode' while respecting the fixed prompt lifecycle in this harness.
